```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Reset the environment
rm(list=ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Pacman is a package that helps you more parsimoniously download and attach other packages
if("pacman" %in% installed.packages() == FALSE) {install.packages("pacman")}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2,
               dplyr,
               tidyverse,
               magrittr,
               foreign,
               ggcorrplot,
               Hmisc,
               psych,
               ggdist,
               rstatix,
               effectsize)

# Set this directory to wherever your own data are saved
setwd("C:/Users/wilso/OneDrive/Desktop/Lab Projects/Disease concealment/Harm x risk re-run (between subjects)/")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in data
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
load("./intermediate/study 2 data, cleaned and recoded.rda")

# Filter out participants who meet pre-registered exclusion criteria
cleaned %<>% filter(problem == 0)
```

# Primary analyses
```{r primary}
# descriptives split by condition
describeBy(select(cleaned, concealment_dv, illness_harm), group = cleaned$illness_harm)
describeBy(select(cleaned, concealment_dv, symp_severity), group = cleaned$symp_severity)

# ANOVA
harm_aov <- aov(concealment_dv ~ trans_risk * symp_severity, data = cleaned)

summary(harm_aov)
cohens_f(harm_aov, alternative = "two.sided")

cleaned %>%
  group_by(trans_risk) %>%
  t_test(concealment_dv ~ symp_severity, detailed = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame()

cleaned %>%
  group_by(trans_risk) %>%
  rstatix::cohens_d(concealment_dv ~ symp_severity)

cleaned %>%
  group_by(symp_severity) %>%
  t_test(concealment_dv ~ trans_risk)

cleaned %>%
  t_test(concealment_dv ~ symp_severity)

cleaned %>%
  rstatix::cohens_d(concealment_dv ~ symp_severity)

cleaned %>%
  t_test(concealment_dv ~ trans_risk)
```

```{r plot}
# Plot the 3x3
tiff("3x3plot.tiff", units="in", width=5, height=5, res=300)

ggplot(cleaned, aes(x = trans_risk, y = concealment_dv, fill = symp_severity, color = symp_severity)) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", alpha = .7, position = "dodge") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = .1,
               position = position_dodge(width = .9), color = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = symp_severity), position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = .9), alpha = .5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Concealment frequency by transmission risk and symptom severity", y = "Likelihood of concealment", x = "Symptom Severity",
       fill = "Transmission Risk") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Mild", "Moderate", "Severe")) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"), values = c("#88CCEE", "#6699CC", "#332288")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#88CCEE", "#6699CC", "#332288")) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black" , size = 12, hjust = .5))

dev.off()
```
